note: Email Contact provides two display formatters for the core 'email' field: email_contact_link (link/modal to a contact form) and email_contact_inline (embedded form). It also adds route email_contact.form, a hook_mail (key 'contact'), config schema for both formatter settings, and an AjaxEmailContactCommandEvent. No global settings page, no permission (access = entity + field view access), no plugins/Drush. The formatter choice lives in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> at content.<field>.type with settings. Medium cases seed an email field on Article whose display uses one of the formatters and the agent reads it back via drush cget; hard cases start the field on the core email_mailto formatter (verify FAILS) and the agent must switch the display formatter to email_contact_link / email_contact_inline. All fields namespaced field_ec_*.

evals.prompt: I want a Drupal email field to show a contact form instead of the raw address, using the email_contact module. What two field formatters does it provide and how do they differ?
evals.expected_output: email_contact_link renders a link (optionally an AJAX modal) to a contact form; email_contact_inline embeds the contact form directly in the field output. Both are formatters for the core 'email' field type, chosen per field in Manage display. Neither shows the address itself.

evals.prompt: There's no settings page for the email_contact module. How do I actually turn an email field into a contact form/link, and where is that choice stored?
evals.expected_output: On the entity's Manage display page set the email field's Format to 'Email contact link' or 'Email contact inline'. It is stored in the entity_view_display config (core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode>) at content.<field>.type (email_contact_link / email_contact_inline) with the formatter's settings. There is no global config (configure=null).

evals.prompt: With the email_contact 'Email contact link' formatter, can the contact form open in a modal, and who receives the message when a visitor submits it?
evals.expected_output: Yes: the email_contact_link formatter has a 'modal' setting that opens the form in an AJAX modal dialog. On submit, hook_mail (key 'contact') sends the message to the address(es) stored in the email field, with the visitor's address as reply-to; the address is never displayed.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has an email field, field_ec_known, displayed via the email_contact module. Inspect the live default view display and report which email_contact formatter it uses and the link text configured for it.
evals.expected_output: field_ec_known uses the email_contact_link formatter with link_text 'Reach the author' (and modal enabled): core.entity_view_display.node.article.default content.field_ec_known type is email_contact_link.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has an email field field_ec_inline configured with the email_contact module. Inspect the live view display and state which formatter it uses and where the inline form redirects the visitor after submission.
evals.expected_output: field_ec_inline uses the email_contact_inline formatter with redirection_to = front (redirect to the front page after submit): content.field_ec_inline type is email_contact_inline.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has an email field field_ec_task whose default display currently uses the core Mailto formatter. Using the email_contact module, change its default view display so the field is shown as a link to a contact form (the email_contact_link formatter). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set content.field_ec_task type to email_contact_link (e.g. $vd->setComponent('field_ec_task', ['type'=>'email_contact_link', ...])->save()). getComponent('field_ec_task')['type'] === 'email_contact_link'.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has an email field field_ec_form whose default display currently uses the core Mailto formatter. Using the email_contact module, change its default view display so the contact form is embedded directly in the page (the email_contact_inline formatter). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set content.field_ec_form type to email_contact_inline and save. getComponent('field_ec_form')['type'] === 'email_contact_inline'.
